name: dumbbell kneeling around head rotation
description: A kneeling dumbbell halo that circles the weight around your head to warm up and mobilize the shoulders.
instructions: Kneel tall holding a dumbbell by one end at chest level.
Circle the dumbbell around your head, keeping it close.
Keep your ribs down and your hips still.
Complete the circle back to the front.
Do a few reps one way, then reverse direction.
